title: How to make a simple FISH TRAP for minnows - TAFishing
description:
Graeme Pullen shows you some very old school and more modern techniques on how to trap minnows that can be used for bait. This Totally Awesome Technique is great if you are needing some bait or even if you need to survive! The technique is very simple to do, using either a used wine bottle or a plastic bottle and just a few small pieces of bread! AWESOME!
